references.text: The same introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, which introduces the previous chapter on the holiness of the priests
The standard formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses' used throughout Leviticus to introduce new sections of law
God speaks to Moses at Mount Sinai, the same pattern of communication between God and Moses
The Lord speaks to Moses in the tent of meeting, the same revelation formula
The Lord speaks to Moses with instructions that are to be passed on to the children of Israel
